items.title: Has the global oil market returned to surplus? JPMorgan thinks so
items.summary: Investing.com -- The global oil market has returned to a surplus after months of supply disruptions linked to the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, with recovering Middle Eastern exports and rising production in Latin America bringing more crude back into circulation, JPMorgan said.

items.title: Inflation Is Running Above 3%. These 3 Dividend Stocks Have the Pricing Power to Keep Up.
items.summary: When inflation eats into your dividend's buying power, pricing power becomes the one trait separating stocks that keep up from those that quietly fall behind. Three consumer giants are charging more and still selling more, and the gap between them matters more than most investors realize.

items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks to Buy in 2027 and Hold for the Next 5 Years
items.summary: Dividend stocks' total returns have historically beaten dividend non-payers by a wide margin.

items.title: European gas rises as U.S. midterms and stalled Hormuz talks cloud outlook
items.summary: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices rose on Wednesday as energy desks assessed the geopolitical fallout from a decisive Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections, while contradictory signals from Washington and an unresolved diplomatic stalemate over the Strait of Hormuz kept a firm risk premium embedded across fuel curves.

items.title: Democrats seize Congress; AMD shares surge - what’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock averages point higher, as investors assess the impact of a major Democratic victory in the American midterm elections. A large wave of support for Democrats leaves the party set to take control of both chambers of Congress and markets pondering a potential move to decelerate the artificial intelligence build-out. Shares of Advanced Micro Devices surge in extended hours trading on an upbeat outlook powered by strong sales of data-center chips.

items.title: Colgate Palmolive (CL) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q3 Earnings Beat
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Colgate-Palmolive has moved from US$98.80 to US$101.70, which points to a modestly higher price target range in the latest analysis. This change lines up with recent Street commentary that responds to the Q3 2026 earnings beat and updated guidance, with both bullish and cautious views feeding into where analysts now set their targets. items.title: Oil extends losses as markets weigh U.S. election outcome, Iran war uncertainty
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices extended losses on Wednesday as investors assessed the implications of the U.S. midterm elections for the conflict in the Middle East, with Democrats capturing control of both chambers of Congress from President Donald Trump’s Republicans.

items.title: Gold jumps above $4,000 as dollar retreats after Democratic midterm win
items.summary: Investing.com -- Gold prices surged on Wednesday, extending their recovery above $3,975 an ounce as the U.S. dollar softened following the U.S. midterm elections. At 09:33 ET (14:33 GMT), spot gold had risen 2.9% to $4,042.36 an ounce, while gold futures also advanced 2.9% to $4,051.67 an ounce.
